note: Getsemani dorms COP 45-70k ($12-18); most expensive city in Colombia for food, street eats $4-8/meal; walled city free, Castillo ~$12 once amortized.
Well-rated Centro/Roma dorms $13-18 (aggregators' $4-7 'average' is outlier junk); tacos/comida corrida $10-15/day; museums cheap, Teotihuacan ~$15 once.
Laureles/Poblado dorms $10-15; menu del dia $3-4; free walking tour, Comuna 13, metrocable rides ~$1.
Antigua dorms $8-15; comedor meals $3-5; Pacaya/Acatenango hike ~$30-40 once amortized. Fare: Kayak RT avg $364, Expedia from $278, Sept cheapest — $300 is a real 6-wk-out low.
Cancun downtown (not hotel zone) dorms $12-18; taqueria eating $10-14/day; public beaches free, one cenote/Isla ferry amortized.
Casco/El Cangrejo dorms $12-17; fondas $3-5/meal; Casco Viejo + Cinta Costera free, Miraflores locks ~$15 once.
Centro/Zona Romantica dorms $14-18; beach free, bus to Mismaloya. Fare: Expedia RT from $392, Google Flights $479, Southwest Sept $445 — no cheap nonstop, $420 realistic low.
San Jose dorms $10-16 (Costa Rica Backpackers from $10); soda casados $5-7; CR day trips carry park entries $15+ — priciest ground costs in Central America.
Bahamas has almost no real hostels — guesthouse-split economics (Bahamas dorm listings run $28-57). Conch shacks/Fish Fry $20-28/day; beaches free. Hardest city to keep cheap.
Real hostels exist (GAVA, Punta Cana Hostel $15-20) away from resorts; local comedores exist but zone is resort-priced; Macao beach free.
MoBay dorms $15-25 (Mobay Kotch, Inez Roots); jerk/patty eating $15-20/day; Doctor's Cave beach charges ~$8 entry — 'free beach' plan is thinner here.
Candelaria dorms $8-14; almuerzo $2.50-4; free museums, graffiti tour (tip), Monserrate ~$7.
Miraflores/Barranco dorms $10-15; menu del dia $3-4, market ceviche $4-6; malecon + centro free.

Dorms avg $12, all under $13; San Pedro market menu $2-4. Fun is tour-heavy: Rainbow Mtn/Sacred Valley $25-35 + boleto turistico — $18/day WITHOUT Machu Picchu (MP entry+train is +$150-200, price it as its own line). Fare: Kayak $418, momondo $511, Expedia $523 RT — $480 fair 6-wk low via LIM.

Copacabana/Lapa dorms $10-18; PF lunch + juice bars $12-16/day; beaches free, Christ ~$15 + Sugarloaf ~$22 once each over 5d. Fare: Kayak/Expedia low $710, momondo deals lower; $650 achievable Oct midweek.

San Telmo/Palermo dorms $12-25 post-inflation (America del Sur from $15); empanadas+parrilla-cheap $12-18/day; city is free-walking heaven. Fare: Expedia RT from $426, Skyscanner $476, Nov cheapest — $500 solid.

Island premium on dorms ($15-20); snorkel-from-shore free but one boat snorkel ~$40 amortized. Fare: Google Flights $496, Travelocity $509, Expedia $551 — OR fly CUN ~$250 + ferry $22, worth flagging.
Few real hostels (Aruba Harmony ~$30-40 dorm; hostelz '€10 avg' not credible); supermarket+local snacks still $20+/day; Eagle/Palm beaches free, $5 round-island bus.
Priced for Caye Caulker (where the plan really lives), dorms $17-25; rice-and-beans $12-15/day; one snorkel trip ~$45-60 amortized over 5d. Fare: Expedia RT from $379, Sept cheap; $420 realistic.

West End dorms $13-20; baleadas cheap but island-import groceries pricey; West Bay reef snorkel free from shore, fun dives ~$40-45. Fare: best-found $492, typical $576-663 — $500 is the defensible low.
El Tunco surf-town dorms $10-15; pupusas $0.75-1 make this the cheapest food line in the region; beach/surf free, board rental ~$10.
Centro dorms $10-15; tlayudas/markets $8-12/day; Monte Alban ~$5, Hierve el Agua colectivo trip ~$12 once. Fare: no nonstop, RT $310-445 range (Oct/Nov cheapest) — $380 fair.
Centro dorms $10-15; cochinita+marquesitas $8-12/day; free nightly cultural events, cenote colectivo day ~$15 amortized. Fare: Kayak $187 found, Viva nonstop RT ~$272 — $270 well-evidenced.
Old town/La Mariscal dorms $8-13; almuerzo $2.50-3.50; old town free, TelefériQo $9, Mitad del Mundo ~$5.
Chile is the expensive Andean country: Bellavista/Lastarria dorms $14-20, menu del dia $6-8; cerros + free walking tours carry the plan.
Island dorms $16-25 (Poc-Na gone, Selina/Nomads tier); Playa Norte free; Ultramar ferry ~$28 RT + occasional golf-cart split.
Tribu dorm $18-40 by season — $22 shoulder is right; island food premium; bioluminescence walk free, sandbar free. Ferry+bus from CUN ~$20 each way sits in transit not fun.
Surf-town dorms $15-22 (pricier than PVR proper); taco stands $10-14/day; surf rental ~$10-15 some days. Fare = PVR: $392-479 evidence, $420.
Lagoon-town dorms $12-18 (Yak Lake House tier); lagoon swimming free from balnearios ($3-5), kayak/sailing amortized; ADO bus from CUN ~$25 each way.
Centro dorms $10-15; the city IS the attraction — callejones, funicular $2, mummies museum ~$5. Fare: BJX RT $311-495 evidence, $380 fair with connection.
SMA is gentrified — dorms $14-20 and street food slightly above Bajio norm; town itself free. Fare = BJX, $380.

US-territory prices: minimal hostel scene, cheapest guesthouses ~$73-110/night (split) — $40/person floor; food trucks $20-28/day; beaches free but bio-bay tour ~$55 amortized over 3d. Add SJU-VQS puddle-jumper or ferry to the transit line.

Bolivia ground costs are the region's cheapest (dorms $6-11, almuerzo $1.50-3) but this trip's point is the Uyuni salt flats: 3-day tour $140-180 + overnight bus, amortized ~$28/day over 5d. Fare: MIA-LPB RT $396-446 evidence, $450.
City-only: dorms $6-11; mercado lunches $1.50-3; teleferico network $0.40/ride is the attraction, Death Road ride optional +$50. Fare: RT $396-446 evidence, $450 (Avianca/BOA via BOG).
Coffee axis (Pereira/Salento): dorms $9-14; menu del dia $3; Cocora valley + finca tour $10-15 amortized. Fare: Avianca via BOG $321-360 evidence, Sept avg $337 — $350 solid.

Puerto Iguazu dorms $10-16; falls entry ~ARS-side $25-30, go twice (2nd day half price) over 4d. Fare is the problem: through-tickets $809-899 (Google $865) — $820 honest, or hack it as MIA-EZE + domestic for ~$620 with self-transfer risk.
Uruguay quietly pricey: Ciudad Vieja dorms $14-20, chivito+mercado eating $15-20/day; rambla and beaches free carry the plan.
Cheapest mainland ground costs with Bolivia: Granada/Leon dorms $8-12, fritanga $2-3/meal; volcano boarding ~$30 once over 6d. Fare: Google Flights $429 recent low, Oct cheap month — $420.

Huaraz dorms $7-12; menu $2-3; trek-tour driven: Laguna 69 day $15-20, Paron ~$20, park entries — amortized $12/day. LIVEFARE row (flies to LIM) + $25-35 overnight bus each way to Huaraz belongs in transit.

Land-based budget mode: San Cristobal/Isabela dorms $12-20, Santa Cruz $15-25; kioskos dinners $6-10 but most food imported; free snorkeling (Concha de Perla, Tortuga Bay) + 1-2 day tours ($110-150) amortized. WARNING: $200 park entry + $20 TCT per person is on top of everything. Fare: Expedia RT $624, Google $744, Sept cheapest — $700 via UIO/GYE.
